messages:
marie (People Ops): Quick heads-up — we’re running a mandatory Privacy & Data‑Handling refresher + team attestation window. Due in 2 weeks: Fri May 9 2025 23:59 PT. Everyone must finish the SecureLearn ‘Privacy 2025’ module and managers must upload a short evidence pack for their team. Links below and details on what to include. :calendar:

marie (People Ops): Training: https://securelearn.example.com/courses/privacy-2025 (single sign-on)
Attestation form: https://forms.example.com/redwood/privacy-attestation-2025
Evidence upload (private Drive): https://drive.example.com/redwood/compliance/2025-privacy-evidence
Naming convention for uploads: `teamname_evidence_YYYYMMDD.zip` — please include a README.txt listing files.

marie (People Ops): What we need per team (short):
- Engineering: architecture/dataflow diagram, retention config snippets, runbook references for data exports/backups, one example query with access control notes.
- Platform/SRE: logs retention policy, S3 lifecycle/rm config, sample audit logs (redacted), incident playbooks referencing PII handling.
- Sales/CS: redacted contract example, DPA checklist signed, opt-out/consent templates.
- Product/Design: UI copy for consent, data minimization notes, any tracking tags.

sahil (InfoSec): Quick clarifier — for audit logs redact user identifiers but keep timestamps and action codes. If you’re unsure how to redact, see our redaction playbook: https://confluence.example.com/display/SEC/Redaction+Playbook

jordan (Eng Manager): If someone is on parental leave/LOA during the window, do they still need to complete training?

marie (People Ops): Good Q — people on approved leave can complete training within 30 days of return. Managers: mark them in the attestation form under the "exceptions" section with expected return date.

alexa (Platform Eng): For engineering evidence, do we need full runbooks or just the sections that touch PII? We have a queued infra migration and don’t want to hold it up.

marie (People Ops): Include the specific sections that touch PII + a short note in README about any pending changes and expected completion date. If a runbook is internal-only, a pointer + excerpt is fine.

tom (Legal): For redacted contracts — use the standard contract-redaction template from Legal (linked in the attestation form). If you need help redacting at scale, contact Legal and we’ll assist.

ciso (Security Lead): This refresh is tied to our ISO readiness run in Q3 and SOC2 maintenance. Please treat the attestation seriously — non‑compliance will trigger manager escalation and could temporarily restrict access to sensitive datasets until resolved. We don’t expect punitive measures for genuine exceptions, but we need coverage for the audit.

jordan (Eng Manager): Can we get a headcount export or list of who on my team still needs training?

devops-bot: Reminder scheduled — automated follow-up will post in #people-ops in 7 days and on the final day.

marie (People Ops): Managers — please submit the attestation form by the deadline and upload the evidence bundle to the Drive link. I’ll compile a tracker and ping teams with missing items after the deadline. If you want People Ops to run a quick 15-min walkthrough for your team, DM me and I’ll schedule.

alexa (Platform Eng): Acknowledged — will consolidate runbook excerpts and upload by next Wed.

sahil (InfoSec): If you’re collecting screenshots of admin consoles, mask account emails before upload. Use `mask-email.sh` from the sec-tools repo if needed.

marie (People Ops): Thanks all. If you hit any blocker, @marie (People Ops) or @sahil (InfoSec) are the primary contacts. Please also cc your manager in the attestation form so they can approve. :thumbsup:
